title: Crispi Zucchini Boats with Soft Cornmeal Filling
description: Polenta-stuffed zucchini sized for two and finished just before serving.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.text: Halve the zucchini lengthwise. Scoop out a shallow channel and mince the scooped flesh. Use {zuc}.

steps.title: Prepare the center
steps.text: Steam the shells for 2 minutes. Cook the minced flesh into the filling.

steps.title: Cook the filling
steps.text: Whisk {cornmeal} into {milk} in a small pan. Add the chopped zucchini flesh and simmer for 8–15 minutes, until the fine cornmeal is tender, stirring, until soft. Stir in {cheddar}. Spoon into the shells.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.text: Brush with {oil}. Place in one layer on the crisper plate in the 4-qt glass container. Fit the adapter and PowerPod and select Air Fry. Cook 10–14 minutes in the Crispi until soft inside and lightly browned on top.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the topping a day ahead. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. The high-water vegetables soften after thawing. Freeze only if texture is secondary. Fridge reheat: warm covered to 165°F; add the topping last. Freezer reheat: thaw in the fridge before warming covered. Use unsalted plant butter or dairy-free cheese where needed. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 144 kcal, 6.6 g protein, 17.1 g total carbohydrate, 6.1 g fat, 2.2 g fiber, 94 mg sodium.
